rules.window: 60 minutes anchored to first eligible interaction; not sliding or aligned to the clock
rules.toySwitch: all photographed toys share the same actor/relation window
rules.blankPhoto: no Moments count or daily-task progress; interaction animation unchanged
rules.midnight: one Moment window may cross midnight; task progress uses each batch's occurrence date
rules.pendingLocalPhoto: durable local count, background confirmation after upload; rejected upload earns no credit

verification.databaseTests: actual migration 258 executed in isolated PGlite, including hour boundaries, photo eligibility, midnight tasks, duplicate receipts, solo and re-pair isolation

production.legacyClients: same API signatures; server checks equipped toy photo and groups by server-time anchored hour; new client's exact occurrence batching ships in its next binary
